mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, name, phone, email, avatar, status, last_login_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, password, name, phone, email, avatar, status, last_login_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND r.code = #{roleCode}
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name
SELECT name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
